defaultValue: Optional NOAA predicted tides move the waterline. Choose a US coastal harmonic station. No automatic location.

Examples: 9414290 San Francisco, 9439040 Astoria, 8518750 The Battery. Your station number is sent to NOAA. Water height follows the low-to-high range of the cached 48-hour forecast, not a depth in meters. No surface line means tides are off, unavailable or expired. Settings and predictions are saved on the phone/watch.
